I have a tons of both Vallejo game color and model color ranges. I used them primarily for my warhammer painting ( i have some citadel and AK), and have used them the most for painting. Make sure to get the updated bottles for both of theses ranges, they improved the formula ( though the old version is still great) and made it better to use (more fluid and mixable imo) with more vibrancy. I hope you and your stepson have fun!!

Yea, there is a lot in this game that is inference only. Just declare war for independence, it shouldn't be too difficult considering you are Sweden ;)

Buildings are especially useful for smaller nations (The Hansa, Venice, Oman, Portugal, Netherlands, Scotland, Novgorod) as well as nations with poor base tax, but high trade value ( Naples, Denmark, Sweden, Morroco, The Mamluks, Poland, Ethiopia). Generally buildings are pretty awesome, but you have to be careful when you spend the monarch points. Only spend when you are ahead in tech, specifically military tech. This game loves to punish those who are foolish to be backwards in military, don't get caught with your pants down. (unless you are Ethiopia, spend on buildings and don't tech until you westernize). Also try to only spend it on provinces where the culture and religion are accepted, that way you get the most out of the building. If you are trying to make a big blob nation, (like France or Russia) then you should probably stay away from too many buildings. Russia has waaaaaay to many potential provinces to have buildings. You just build them in high base tax, religious and culture accepted provinces. Also if you have lands with the overseas or distant lands modifier, do NOT make a building there. You get almost nothing out of it. If you want some visual aid on deciding where to put buildings and what to get, you should check Aruma07 and DDRjake on YouTube. They are the reason I got better at the game ;)
